rows: vrops01 - FQDN vrops01.example.mil, then its 3 review(s): Not a Finding 1, Open 1, Not Applicable 1
sections.text: The approval step's next job writes exactly these reviews - nothing else: no collection, user, STIG or other review is changed, and no asset but the new ones (NEW ASSET: created with that name and every STIG its checklists matched, then the checklists' answers written as its reviews - 3 of them, counted in its row; the update does not create one that is there by then). Each review is written only if it is still as it was read here (STIG Manager now); one changed since is left, and said. The detail is the checklist's finding details, the comment its comments and where it came from. Not Reviewed in a checklist is never written.
sections.title: Approve writes these reviews to STIG Manager and creates 1 asset
